payload.author: claude
payload.body: Opt-in server-side device binding (FRICK_BIND_SESSION_DEVICE / FrickLimits.bindSessionDevice, default OFF). Gateway #authenticateHelloSession now compares Hello deviceId+replicaId against the session-bound values; mismatch -> auth.unauthenticated Nack (reason sessionDeviceMismatch) + 1008 close so client re-auths. Principal device/replica still always server-derived. Tests: ws-session-device-binding.test.ts + limits.test.ts env/default coverage. CHANGELOG + threat-model updated. typecheck=0, server vitest 847 passed / 45 skipped.
